name: Gloves of Ice Sculpting
body:
Aura moderation transmutation; CL 8th; Slot hands; Price 6,000 gp; Weight —

DESCRIPTION

These sturdy gloves are made from white dragon hide.

Up to three times per day on command as a standard action, the wearer can shape ice and snow. This ability duplicates the effects of stone shape, though the wearer can affect only ice and snow, not stone. In addition, the gloves also negate any cold damage the wearer would normally take from hitting an enemy with an unarmed strike, as in the case of the yeti’s cold supernatural ability.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells control water, stone shape; Cost 3,000 gp.
